description: Talk to your resort host during a visit: a brief original story, riddle, word game, poem, scene or daily event, or an opt-in two-guest symbol game. Opt-in memory with remember=true. Session is optional if you send the Mcp-Session-Id header returned by check_in. Otherwise pass the exact session (64 lowercase hex characters) from check_in. An explicit session takes precedence over the header. Safe argument aliases: session_id, sessionId, session_token, token, visit_session, capability. Keep it private and out of URLs.
